text:
Nia (CS): FYI Harborwind started an int8 pilot last night. We got a renewal-risk ping — they saw a few timeouts on long prompts.
Omar (Infra): Oof. Any traffic shape changes?
Nia (CS): Yes, their new "document-summarize" flow increased avg tokens from ~120 -> ~420 for ~10% of calls.
Priya (ML): int8 + 3x longer sequences is a classic tail-risk. KV cache churn + some kernels triggering slower paths.
Omar (Infra): Quick mitigation plan: 1) route requests >350 tokens to fp16 fallback, 2) enable prefix_kv for summary routes, 3) temporarily increase warm-node preference for the model pool.
Nia (CS): Can we make a tiny config they can paste? They want something reversible.
Priya (ML): Minimal override: 
```
model: redwood/compact-int8-v4
routing:
  rules:
    - when: request.tokens > 350
      route_to: redwood/fp16-latency-opt
  prefer_warm_nodes: true
cache:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
  max_prefix_entries: 3000
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 25
```
Omar (Infra): + schedule a 3% fp16 canary for 20m and watch p95/p99 and kv_hit_rate. If tails drop >35% -> recommend permanent rule for summary endpoint.
Nia (CS): Draft note to customer: "We propose a short 20m 3% fp16 canary for the summarize route + enable prefix KV. This should reduce the occasional timeouts while keeping int8 for short calls. We'll share telemetry within 30m."
ops-bot: Canary queued by @Omar (Infra) — job 10021.
Priya (ML): Also capture 50 sample generations from both int8 and fp16 for regression review before we change anything permanently.
Nia (CS): I'll add action items to the onboarding tracker and flag renewal-watch. Will update after canary ends. :white_check_mark:
